scene: The opened pastry case reveals magical travel tokens for three distant destinations.
picture: A flat side-view pixel lobby where grandmother and her white dog stand holding travel tokens. On the left, open brass doors lead to a waiting gondola drone. In the centre, an open archway frames a gilded hover carriage. On the right, a sliding gate opens to a docked hover metro train.
shown: A tethered gondola drone waiting outside the open brass doors on the left.
A gilded hover carriage idling at the curbside archway in the centre.
